entities.summary: Walter Edward Block is an American Austrian School economist and anarcho-capitalist theorist. He is the Harold E. Wirth Eminent Scholar Endowed Chair in Economics at the School of Business at Loyola University New Orleans and a former senior fellow of the non-profit think-tank Ludwig von Mises Institute in Auburn, Alabama.
